positions.name: MeridianGateFieldSpecification
positions.frame: What does the ratified deployment-gate specification consist of, and how is authority distributed across its labeled fields?
positions.why: All three are footed identically (fc-1: Xena animating/authoring, Quinton Fairweather as principal) and share the same terse label-colon-value field format — Gate, Scope, Owner — read across the dimensional passes as one register (formal/technical, GateSpecAsTerseFieldProtocol), one relational stance (authority-ranking), one power basis (legitimate), and one conviction (decision, performed as settled and ratified rather than argued for). The three fields together specify the condition, jurisdiction, and accountable party of a single enacted gate — a directional read distinct from src-1/src-2, which carry the rule's original unfooted utterance and its causal rationale rather than the recorded specification itself.
